name: quickimage
description: A launcher-style desktop app for finding, editing and copying images without leaving your keyboard.
author: QuickImage

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.selftest: electron-vite build && npm run bundle:script -- scripts/selftest.ts --outfile=out/main/selftest.cjs && electron out/main/selftest.cjs
scripts.test:editor: electron-vite build && npm run bundle:script -- scripts/test-editor.ts --outfile=out/main/test-editor.cjs && electron out/main/test-editor.cjs
scripts.capture: electron-vite build && npm run bundle:script -- scripts/capture.ts --outfile=out/main/capture.cjs && electron out/main/capture.cjs
